subject: bootstrap/upgrade: split definition and code logic for better maintenance (#65403)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent with focus on DDL/add-index/infoschema/dxf + metadata/upgrade behavior. Change is a refactor: system table SQL definitions move into `pkg/meta/metadef/system_tables_def.go` (including DDL/DXF tables previously in `pkg/ddl/constant.go`), upgrade runtime logic moves from `pkg/session/bootstrap.go` to `pkg/session/upgrade_run.go`, and call sites update to reference `metadef` constants (e.g. notifier table name and CREATE TABLE SQL). Confirmed DDL/DXF table schemas and upgrade control-flow are preserved; no Blocker/High issues found in correctness, data consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine handling.
